Match Report

Up against our toughest opponent to date, the team showed grit and determination to give it all they've got up until the final whistle. Having gone down by a wonder goal our girls kept their heads up and scored 2 unanswered goals to go up 2-1 at half time. Second half was a tough battle without subs and even playing short 1 player for a few minutes. A further goal was scored by each side in the second half, with our superstars coming away with a hard fought 3-2 win.

What Went Well

Defense solid as always. Midfielders and attackers pressure on the opponents. Big improvement in speed and effectiveness of throw-ins (as practiced)

Improvements

Defending opponents quick goal kicks and throw-ins. Constantly scanning of teammates and opponents.
